label: LAX general aviation landing fee
note: Effective March 1 2026, approved by LAWA Board of Airport Commissioners Jan 2026. Billed on arrival at max landing weight, fixed-wing only. Applies to GA category broadly; does not separate private from charter. No parking/overnight fee listed on this source.

label: Super Bowl week parking cost pattern across LVII-LIX
note: LVII/LVIII showed fees unchanged from standard, with scarcity (full parking) as the real constraint, not price. LIX reports a higher $3000/day figure but source/airport unconfirmed. No landing-fee-specific surge data found for any of LVI-LX.

label: General presidential/VIP TFR structure (non-SB)
value: presidential 10-12NM/18000ft full GA prohibition; VP-level ~3NM with arrivals held during actual movement; ramp access often closed
note: NBAA industry guidance, not a government source but the standard operator reference. SB LVI's structure matches the presidential tier, suggesting comparable security posture.

label: SB LVI 99.7 Special Security Instruction TFR inner-ring duration
note: 1430-2030 PST Feb 13 2022. Full flight-operations prohibition surface to FL180 within 10NM of SoFi Stadium, no GA exception. LAX sits inside this radius.

label: SB LVI TFR inner ring radius
note: All flight ops prohibited except law enforcement/military/air ambulance and TSA-screened Part 121/125 at Part 139 airports; Long Beach Class D departures exempt.

label: SB LVI TFR outer ring radius
note: 10-30NM: transit-only, active IFR/VFR flight plan + ATC-assigned discrete squawk + continuous radio contact required, no loitering.
